title.narrative: DE-CONFLICT: Dialogue and Engagement in Communities to Foster Peaceful Camps Transformation

description.narrative: The Actions over-all objective is to contribute to the successful implementation of camps transformation and the overall sustainability of the peace process by fostering a peaceful, inclusive and secure enabling environment (IMPACT).Specifically, it will aim to strengthen social cohesion and community resilience against violent conflict in the camps (OUTCOME). In addition, the Action will also produce processes are developed for inclusive community participation in the implementation of the Camps Transformation Plan (Other Outcome).
